source: 3GPP TR 38.821 transparent payload: gNB and core on the ground, the satellite relays Uu between the service and feeder links + author_defined TT&C chain (as G-CONV)

moc.security_domain_basis: assumed: mission-operator ground segment inside the same administrative authority as its satellites (author_defined TT&C chain; not stated by D3.7/D5.3)

gs_primary.security_domain_basis: assumed: mission-operator ground segment inside the same administrative authority as its satellites (author_defined TT&C chain; not stated by D3.7/D5.3)

rogue_gs.security_domain_basis: assumed: attacker-controlled station is outside every legitimate administrative authority by construction

sat_service.security_domain_basis: assumed: one operator's satellites are one administrative authority (plan v5 §1.2 reading of TS 33.210; the architecture sources do not state security-domain membership)

functions.payload_relay: transparent payload: frequency conversion and amplification of Uu, no RAN function

gnb_ground.security_domain_basis: assumed: ground gNB run by the mobile network operator together with the core (TR 38.821 places the gNB at the gateway side); source does not state security-domain membership

functions.ran_gnb_ground: full gNB on the ground behind the NTN gateway

core.security_domain_basis: assumed: core network run by a distinct mobile network operator (existing `domain` value mno); source does not state security-domain membership

fsw_pipeline.security_domain_basis: assumed: mission-operator ground segment inside the same administrative authority as its satellites (author_defined TT&C chain; not stated by D3.7/D5.3)

atlo.security_domain_basis: assumed: integration site is run by a separate integrator (existing `domain` value integrator)

functions.integration_site: assembly, test and launch operations site

edges.figure_alias_basis: interpretation: both ends on the ground; Table I places TT&C/SOC (SLE-SDL) at TB2
edges.use_optionality_basis: assumed: author-defined ground link; no source specifies a mechanism

edges.figure_alias_basis: stated: Fig. 2, TR52 crosses TB2 on the TT&C command path
edges.use_optionality_basis: assumed: SDLS use on the TC uplink is not stated by any pinned source; SIs record the realized state in protection_applied

edges.figure_alias_basis: interpretation: same TC uplink as E-TCUL, from a rogue station
edges.use_optionality_basis: assumed: same TC uplink as E-TCUL

edges.figure_alias_basis: interpretation: feeder link between ground and space
edges.use_optionality_basis: source: TR 38.821: the transparent payload relays the radio signal and performs no authentication; Uu security (TS 33.501) is end-to-end between UE and the ground gNB

edges.figure_alias_basis: interpretation: ground gNB to ground core
edges.use_optionality_basis: source: TS 33.210 NDS/IP: integrity protection is mandatory between security domains (Za), optional within one (Zb); here gNB and core are both in SD-MNO (assumed), so Zb applies
assumed: author-defined artifact path; no mechanism specified

edges.figure_alias_basis: none: physical custody is not one of the paper's five boundaries
edges.use_optionality_basis: assumed: author-defined physical custody; no mechanism specified
